newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: EEI divests stakes in two Manila firms.
newsitem.headline: EEI divests stakes in two Manila firms.

text.p: Philippine engineering and construction firm EEI Corp said on Monday it had sold its stake in Gulf Asia Travel Corporation. Vice president Ferdinand Villafuerte said in a statement that the company also offered to sell its equity in EEI-TOEI Animation Corp to its partner TOEI Animation Co Ltd of Japan.
The sales were in line with the company's programme to rationalise its operations, Villafuerte said. -- Manila newsroom (63 2) 841-8936, Fax 817-6267
